title: 🌀 LinkedIn Feed Vanisher
tagline: Say goodbye to the LinkedIn noise. Hello, focus. ✨
warning: Work in progress: This project is under active development and not final. Features, behavior, and instructions may change without notice.
description: LinkedIn is a fantastic networking tool — but that **infinite scrolling news feed** is a productivity black hole. Endless posts, humble-brags, and AI-generated "thought leadership" can derail your entire afternoon.

**LinkedIn Feed Vanisher** is a lightweight browser extension that makes the feed _disappear_ with a single click. Use LinkedIn for what it's actually good for — messaging, jobs, profiles — without the distraction of the feed.

comparison.after: You're in control of your attention
Get in, do your thing, get out

features: 🚫 **Hides the LinkedIn news feed** on `linkedin.com/feed/` and the home page
🔘 **One-click toggle** via the browser toolbar popup
💾 **Remembers your preference** — feed stays hidden across page reloads
🔵 **Badge indicator** on the toolbar icon shows active/inactive state

installation.title: 🟡 Chrome / Chromium / Edge / Brave
steps: Run `npm install && npm run sync` to generate the extension package:
Enable **Developer Mode** (toggle in the top-right corner)
Select the **`chrome.package/`** folder from the cloned repository
The 🌀 icon will appear in your toolbar. Click it to toggle the feed!
notes: 💡 **Edge:** Go to `edge://extensions/` and follow the same steps.
💡 **Brave:** Go to `brave://extensions/` and follow the same steps.

installation.title: 🦊 Firefox
steps: Run `npm install && npm run sync` to generate the extension package:
Click **"This Firefox"** in the left sidebar
Navigate to the **`firefox.package/`** folder and select **`manifest.json`**
The 🌀 icon will appear in your toolbar!
